description: Gives people access to a site (owner). collaborator: a Site Collaborator (on a workspace site a Workspace Collaborator, a seat). viewer: that site only, no seat. workspace_viewer: every workspace site, no seat. member: Site Members (emails or domains) of an invite-only site. Returns approve_url.

confirm_token.description: From the first call (site only): approval status

emails.description: Email addresses; for visitor also company domains, e.g. acme.com (required unless confirm_token)

notify.description: member: email each new address (default true)

permissions.description: collaborator: exactly these ticks; for existing collaborators, changes theirs

role.description: Required unless confirm_token. An audience (students, clients) is member. viewer also sees versions and people

name: add_people
title: Add people
